title: Setup → Notification Preferences: Topic and Channel are free-text boxes, so muting one topic means typing its machine name — offer pickers over the topics and channels the platform knows (hotcrm#2194 T2-U15, the remainder)
body:
## 维护者速读

- **事由：** 通知偏好里的「主题」「渠道」仍是手填文本，要靠输入机器名来静音某个主题。
- **要做：** 原定并入 #24775，但该卡在裁决前已关闭。用户选择器已由 #24895 做完，订阅对象已退役；剩下的是主题和渠道改为可选列表。
- **完成标准：** 新建偏好时从列表选主题和渠道。

Filing gate **③ a task the maintainer set**: the maintainer's ruling on objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2194, recorded there at `6354968262` (the director seat, posting from the maintainer's account): 「25251 B hotcrm B」, 2026-10-23T01:05:47Z. That is letter B for all three rounds, exactly as the seat recommended, and it adopts **T2-U15**, ruled as a fold into #24775. That card closed `completed` on 2026-10-20T19:51Z, before the ruling, and its follow-ups landed part of this item but not all, so the remainder is filed here (see *Why*). Filed by the `repo:hotcrm` seat 1 (`os-elon-musk`, session `session_014xanhPEmGTMTfVH4UokwJT`) under objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2194's *After the ruling*. ⛔ Not a claim.

**Grade:** triage's. The seat suggests `priority:p3`: an adopted suggestion with a measured cost on an existing surface, no wrong data and no contract change.

**Reader (who acts):** objectstack triage routes and grades it. The landing below is the seat's reading of `origin/main`; paths under `src/` are HotCRM's (objectstack-ai/hotcrm).

## Governing text

- The ruling above. Per objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2194's own governing text, this item is an adopted suggestion through filing gate ②, not a defect card, and a platform or console landing is changed there, never re-implemented in HotCRM: 「平台相关的功能，应该尽量先改平台。」 (maintainer, 2026-10-18, ledger `6245607810`).

## Why (measured)

- **Page / persona:** Setup → Notification Preferences (and, in round 1, Subscriptions), the system administrator.
- **Round 1:** free-text "User\*: Recipient user id, or '\*'", "Principal: 'role:x' | 'team:x' | 'user:id' | …", and free-text topic and channel. Muting one user required pasting a 32-character id. Evidence: objectstack-ai/hotcrm [track 2 report, *UI and UX suggestions*](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/ed4f40e42b8b6ce059a4e648f25f8f6037ffd9f6/qa/2026-10-20-setup-pass/REPORT.md), U-15; [`32-config-notification-preferences-new.png`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/ed4f40e42b8b6ce059a4e648f25f8f6037ffd9f6/qa/2026-10-20-setup-pass/shots/32-config-notification-preferences-new.png), [`33-config-notification-subscriptions-new.png`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/ed4f40e42b8b6ce059a4e648f25f8f6037ffd9f6/qa/2026-10-20-setup-pass/shots/33-config-notification-subscriptions-new.png).
- **What has landed since:** `user_id` is a `sys_user` lookup (#24895, closed), so the person is picked; `sys_notification_subscription` is retired in 18 (`packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.sys-notification-subscription-retired.ts`).
- **What remains:** Topic and Channel are still typed.

## Landing

Read on objectstack `origin/main` `7b047b44`:
- `packages/services/service-messaging/src/objects/notification-preference.object.ts`: `topic: Field.text` ("Notification topic, or '*' for all topics.", ~:124) and `channel: Field.text` ("Channel id (inbox/email/push/…), or '*' for all channels.", ~:140).
- Channels are the registered `MessagingChannel.id`s; topics are the `sys_notification.topic` values the platform and apps emit. The dev measures whether either set is enumerable today. Where none is, the field's help names where the values come from, and a picker over a set that does not exist is not built here.

## Done when

- New Notification Preference offers Channel as a choice among the registered channels plus "all", and Topic as a choice among the known topics plus "all", wherever the platform can enumerate them.
- A typed value the platform cannot match stays refused or warned as today.
- Pins on the field declarations.

**Size:** M.

## Dedupe

Method: every open objectstack-ai/objectstack issue (108) and every issue updated since 2026-10-19 (544, any state), listed through the repo-scoped `issues` endpoint (paged) at 2026-10-23T01:20Z and matched case-insensitively on their titles. Words: `notification preference`, `topic`, `channel`. 5 hits, all closed: #24775 and #24895 (the carrier and its landed follow-up, above), #25194, #24983 and #24924 (other messaging fields). **New.**
